data.title: 猫猫 · 后宫庭院的採集
data.description: 清晨宫苑，猫猫蹲在小径边，用放大镜观察带露水的植物，再把素描卡放在旁边做记录。长裙下摆靠着草叶，她找到关注细节后露出满足的浅笑。

data.promptProse: Maomao crouches beside the palace-garden path, examining a dew-covered plant through a magnifying glass and placing a sketch card nearby for notes. Her modest green jacket and long skirt lie clear of the wet leaves as a tiny discovery brings a satisfied smile. The medium portrait includes the path and planting edge. Morning light catches dew and lens rim, with translucent leaf highlights and small hand shadows marking the careful observation.
